verdict.rationale: MotherDuck documents several ways to drive it programmatically. Official drivers and APIs cover multiple languages, with SDKs for Python, Node.js, Go, Rust, R and Java. It also offers a Postgres-compatible endpoint, a Wasm client library for browser apps, and a remote MCP server whose tools run read-only and read-write SQL. A probe confirmed a published OpenAPI spec at motherduck.com/openapi.json. Missing for 10: documentation of what the OpenAPI/REST surface covers (endpoints and management operations), and independent or hands-on corroboration of programmatic use.
